newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian Stocks to Watch Today - Nov 25.
newsitem.headline: Australian Stocks to Watch Today - Nov 25.

text.p: Some Australian stocks to watch this morning:
WMC Ltd said it will hammer out details next week of its US$100 million gold project in the former Soviet republic of Uzbekistan, a company official said.
Metway Bank Ltd said that ANZ's NZ managing director, Steve Jones, had been appointed CEO of the yet-to-be merged Suncorp/Metway/QIDC Queensland bank.
The Australian Stock Exchange said on Monday that trade in Forrestania Gold shares would be halted at the request of the company until the start of trade on Tuesday or until an announcement

Small electricity generator Pacific Hydro Ltd said it had signed a deal to become a one third partner in a consortium to build a hydro-electric power plant in the Philippines for about A$185 million. The consortium would supply power to the Philippines' state-owned National Power Corp worth more than A$530 million over 25 years.
Diversified manufacturer Hills Industries Ltd was on track for an improved profit in 1996/97, compared with the previous year, managing director David Simmons said on Friday.
